evidence_quotes.O: I spent a bit of time reading up and testing on this unit before writing this review
evidence_quotes.C: Update June 2014: After almost 3 years, this adapter is still going strong.
evidence_quotes.E: My previous receivers all have been lower end models so I was chuffed to obtain a higher end receiver to review.
evidence_quotes.A: But then, you can't expect budding enthusiasts to shell out $1000 for a new pair of binocs for something they don't know if they'll like or not.
evidence_quotes.N: No muss no fuss and for 3 bucks, I saved myself from having to buy a new printer and lose those expensive cartridges.
